purpose: 아이콘 정체성 그대로 무기 3D(검성 아르카 sword/greatsword 형태). 1차는 등급 대표 4자루로 파이프라인 끝까지 통과.
flow: 1. Tripo Image(무료 쿼터): 참조 이미지 = 아이콘 PNG(R2 blade-surge-handoff/<iconKey>), 아래 conceptPrompt + extra 로 정측면 원화 1장
2. Tripo H3.1 이미지→3D(텍스처·PBR 켬), 원화 그대로
4. GLB와 원화 PNG를 R2 blade-surge-handoff/tripo-3d/weapons/<id>.glb, <id>-concept.png 로 업로드 + task id 기록
conceptPrompt: Orthographic side view concept art of the exact same weapon shown in the reference image: keep the identical silhouette, colors, materials, gem placement and ornaments. The weapon stands perfectly vertical with the blade pointing straight up and the hilt at the bottom, flat-on view of the blade face, the entire weapon visible with empty margin around it, on a flat pure white background, no shadow, no perspective distortion, no hands, no text. Stylized hand-painted low-poly game asset with chunky readable shapes, every ornament solidly attached to the weapon (nothing floating).
